validity.recommendation: No action beyond the two spec caveats below.
validity.researcher_notes: Existence, classification, endpoints, length, diameter, cost, fuel source and owner all check out against multiple INDEPENDENT sources, not just the sheet's own cited refs. Route Kokshetau->Petropavlovsk, 177 km, is Stage 3 of the 4-stage Saryarka project and is corroborated by THREE independent outlets that agree to the decimal: kapital.kz/74365 (Dec 2018: 'Кокшетау-Петропавловск... 177 км... 18,9 млрд тенге'), kdb.kz/8236 (Oct 2019: same 177 km / 18.9bn tenge), and blacksea-caspia.eu (Dec 2019, reporting on Stage 1's commissioning, which also recaps Stage 3 as '177 км... 426 мм' diameter) -- so length AND diameter (426mm) both get 2+ independent agreement, high tier. SegmentCost 18,900,000,000 KZT is genuinely supported by kapital.kz/74365 and kdb.kz/8236 even though url_verifier's literal-digit check on kapital.kz flagged a miss -- the article states it as '18,9 млрд тенге', a prose/unit equivalent of 18,900,000,000, not a defect (per the standing prose-equivalence rule). PipelineType=transmission is correct -- this is explicitly a national gasification trunk line, not a gathering/feeder line. FuelSource 'Karachaganak, Tengiz, Kashagan' is directly confirmed by kapital.kz/79860 ('газ с отечественных месторождений Карачаганак, Тенгиз и Кашаган', reverse-flow via the Central Asia-Center system) -- correct as recorded, applies system-wide across all Saryarka stages including this one. No duplicate concern against the roster: P3307 (Stage 2, Astana-Kokshetau, 630mm) and P3309 (len=0, capacity-expansion-only Stage 4 compressor addition) are genuinely distinct phases of the same project, correctly split into separate PIDs by segment, not a double-count of P3308's own Kokshetau-Petropavlovsk stage.

validity.recommendation: Do not treat Capacity=2.20 bcm/y as a verified Stage-3-specific figure. Either re-source it to something that actually states Stage 3's own throughput, or annotate it in ResearcherNotes as a system-level/Stage-1 figure carried across stages rather than a confirmed per-segment value.
validity.researcher_notes: The row's own cited ref for Capacity (neftegaz.ru/481053) does NOT support this value for THIS segment. Read in full, the article states: 'Общая протяженность газопровода по маршруту Кызылорда - Жезказган - Караганда - Темиртау - Нур-Султан составит 1061 км. Пропускная мощность - 2,2 млрд м3/год газа' -- i.e. 2.2 bcm/y is explicitly attached to the Kyzylorda-Nur-Sultan route, which is STAGE 1 (a different PID's segment, 1061-1081 km, 820mm diameter per blacksea-caspia), not Stage 3 (Kokshetau-Petropavlovsk, 177 km, 426mm). No independent source found states a Stage-3-specific throughput figure. blacksea-caspia.eu gives only ONE system-wide figure, and it is for after Stage 4's compressor stations are built (2028-2031 per that article): 'увеличит пропускную способность всего проекта до 3 млрд м3/год' (3 bcm/y). nangs.org (Dec 2023) discusses a DIFFERENT capacity expansion (606,000->801,000 m3/hour, ~5.3-7.0 bcm/y annualized) tied to the Beyneu-Bozoy-Shymkent line dependency, not clearly this segment either. Roster context: P3307 (Stage 2, 630mm) ALSO carries Capacity=2.20, identical to Stage 1's and P3308's figure, despite the progressively smaller pipe diameter downstream (820mm->630mm->426mm) that would normally imply progressively lower design throughput -- this pattern (same number copied onto three differently-sized segments) is consistent with the 2.2 bcm/y headline figure being carried across stages rather than independently verified per segment.

validity.recommendation: Clear or update StartYear1 (currently 2025) -- it is a stale, twice-superseded planning target, not a current estimate. Also change DelayType from 'inferred' to 'confirmed' (lowercase per controlled vocab) since the delay is directly documented, not dormancy-inferred; cite the refs below.
validity.researcher_notes: This is the date-logic defect the orchestrator flagged (ConstructionYear 2028 > StartYear1 2025). Tracing the target date across three dated, independent sources shows genuine schedule slippage, not a data-entry slip: (1) the Sept-2023 General Gasification Scheme (adilet.zan.kz/G23JVM00350, para near #z250) states stages 2-3 were to be completed 'до 2025 года до городов Кокшетау и Петропавловска' -- this is where the sheet's current StartYear1=2025 comes from; (2) nangs.org (Dec 2023) reports the target had already moved to 'планируется завершить в 2026 году', contingent on the Beyneu-Bozoy-Shymkent second line; (3) 24.kz (Aug 5, 2025 -- the most recent dated evidence found, close to the sheet's own 2025-09-01 LastUpdated) reports 'Строительство 2 и 3 этапов магистрального газопровода Saryarka запланировано на 2028 год', i.e. construction of stages 2-3 hasn't even STARTED yet and is now scheduled to begin in 2028. So StartYear1=2025 is not merely inconsistent with ConstructionYear=2028, it is three years obsolete: the plan slipped 2025->2026->(construction not begun, now targeted)2028. No source gives a new in-service estimate, so I have not proposed a replacement year (recommend blank rather than fabricate one) -- but ConstructionYear=2028 itself IS current and well-supported by the Aug-2025 evidence, and Status=proposed is also correctly current (nothing has broken ground as of Aug 2025). Also note the government's June-2025 Комплексный план (adilet.zan.kz/P2500000463) only itemizes Stage 4 of Saryarka (2027 commissioning target, 180.7bn tenge) -- it does not mention Stages 2-3 at all, consistent with those stages not yet being formally scheduled/funded as of mid-2025.

fills.researcher_notes: Owner1 was correct but MISSING_REF. Baiterek (Samruk-Kazyna/Kazyna Capital Management holding) states directly that the whole Saryarka pipeline project 'is being implemented by AstanaGaz KMG JSC'; kdb.kz independently names AstanaGaz (АстанаГаз) as the project company as well. Two independent sources, high tier. Note: this confirms the PROJECT OWNER/implementer for the Saryarka system as a whole, of which this Stage-3 segment is a part.

StartState/Province and EndState/Province were genuinely blank. Kokshetau is the administrative center of Akmola Region; Petropavlovsk is the administrative center of North Kazakhstan (Soltustik Qazaqstan) Region. inform.kz's Feb-2024 piece on precisely this Stage 2-3 project frames it as serving 'Акмолинской и Северо-Казахстанской областей' (Akmola and North Kazakhstan regions), directly matching the two endpoints. Single strong source -> medium tier; the province identification itself is basic/undisputed geography.

Delay [ref] was MISSING_REF and DelayType was set to 'inferred' (a GEM-rule dormancy guess). This is wrong: the delay is directly and repeatedly documented in dated sources, so per controlled_vocab.md DelayType should be 'confirmed', not 'inferred'. Evidence: the 2023 gasification scheme targeted completion by 2025; by Dec 2023 (nangs.org) the target had already moved to 2026; by Aug 2025 (24.kz) construction of stages 2-3 hadn't started and was pushed to begin only in 2028. That is a sourced, multi-step slippage, exactly what 'confirmed' delay means.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Newest independent evidence found is 24.kz, Aug 5, 2025 (close to the sheet's 2025-09-01 LastUpdated -- this appears to already be the source behind the current update): construction of Stages 2 and 3 of the Saryarka pipeline (i.e. the Astana-Kokshetau and Kokshetau-Petropavlovsk segments, of which P3308 is the latter) 'запланировано на 2028 год' (is planned for 2028) with Kokshetau still awaiting the pipe. Nothing has broken ground on this segment as of the most recent evidence -- Status=proposed is correct and current. Cross-checked the government's June-2025 Комплексный план (adilet.zan.kz/P2500000463): it schedules ONLY Stage 4 (2027 commissioning) and does not mention Stages 2-3 at all, consistent with those stages still being pre-construction/proposed. Separately flagged in validity: the sheet's StartYear1=2025 and DelayType='inferred' are stale/wrong given this same evidence (the target has slipped 2025->2026->2028), but the Status label itself (proposed) is right.

summary: P3308 (Saryarka Stage 3, Kokshetau-Petropavlovsk, 177 km) is a real, correctly classified, well-corroborated in-dev pipeline -- confirmed (caveat) on existence/length/diameter/cost/fuel/owner -- but carries two spec concerns: Capacity=2.20 bcm/y is misattributed (its own cited source states that figure for the different Stage 1 segment, not this one) and StartYear1=2025 is a stale, twice-superseded planning target (slipped 2025->2026->2028, so DelayType should be 'confirmed' not 'inferred'). Status=proposed is confirmed current as of Aug 2025. Filled Owner1 ref, StartState/Province+EndState/Province, and Delay ref/DelayType with verified independent sources. No UNRESOLVED items.
